1.0.0: CreateAgentRuntime supports both container image (Amazon ECR) and code (Amazon S3) artifact types.
Renamed the NewRuntimeSession trigger to NewMemorySession to reflect that it polls AgentCore Memory sessions.
1.0.1: Fix uncaught JSON.parse errors in CreateEvent and CreateAgentRuntime — invalid input now raises a user-friendly CancelError.
Fix environmentVariables schema type mismatch in CreateAgentRuntime (object → string to match textarea inspector).
Fix misleading description in FindMemoryRecords (now reflects full auto-pagination behaviour).
Fix MakeApiCall E2E test flow to use GET instead of POST to avoid resource creation during validation.
